metaTitle: Custom Rectangular Badge ID Holders | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom rectangular badge ID holders in bulk at Perfect Imprints. Ideal for events, security, and daily ID needs.
introHtml: Rectangular badge ID holders offer a classic, professional shape that fits standard ID cards and access badges without excess material. Unlike die-cut or specialty shapes, rectangular holders stack neatly, insert smoothly into badge printers, and present a clean, uniform look across your team. Whether you need clear vinyl pouches for tradeshows or durable nylon neck wallets for daily security use, rectangular holders provide reliable card protection and easy scanning. Customize with your logo or text for a polished, branded appearance.
heroAltText: Custom rectangular badge ID holders with clear vinyl pouches and lanyards for professional identification.
